code_of_conduct.title: Student Code of Conduct – GITS
code_of_conduct.preamble: All students enrolled at GITS are expected to uphold the values of academic integrity, mutual respect, and responsible citizenship. Violations of this code may result in disciplinary action.
general_conduct_rules: Students must carry their GITS ID card at all times on campus.
Students must adhere to the prescribed dress code during academic hours.
Ragging in any form – physical, verbal, or online – is strictly prohibited and is a cognizable offense under law.
Use of tobacco, alcohol, or any intoxicating substances is strictly forbidden on campus and in hostels.
Gambling in any form is prohibited.
Students must not engage in any political activity, demonstration, or strike on campus without prior written permission.
Damage to college property will be penalized with a fine equal to the replacement cost plus 25%.
Students must not loiter in corridors during class hours.
Students must switch off or silence mobile phones during lectures, labs, and examinations.
Students must maintain decorum and dignity in all interactions with faculty, staff, and fellow students.
Cyberbullying, harassment via social media, or any form of online misconduct related to the college community is punishable.
Students must not solicit donations or conduct sales/promotions on campus without permission.
Use of unfair means during exams will be treated as malpractice per UGC and university guidelines.
Students must report any suspicious activity or safety concerns to the security office or their HOD immediately.
Any media interaction (interviews, press releases) on behalf of the college requires prior written approval from the Principal's office.

boys.weekdays: Plain formal shirt (white/light colours), dark trousers, closed shoes
boys.lab_days: Same as above; open footwear not permitted inside labs
boys.exceptions: Cultural event days as announced; sports gear in sports complex

girls.weekdays: Salwar kameez / Kurta with dupatta, or formals (shirt + trouser). Churidar with dupatta is also acceptable.

general: Torn or excessively tight clothing is not allowed
College T-shirts and sweatshirts may be worn on Saturdays
Sports kit permitted only in the sports complex and designated areas

mobile_phone_policy.in_classrooms: Strictly not allowed to use during class. Must be kept on silent/vibrate.
mobile_phone_policy.in_labs: Not allowed unless the experiment requires it and faculty has explicitly permitted.
mobile_phone_policy.in_library: Calls are prohibited; can be used in silent mode for research purposes.
mobile_phone_policy.during_exams: Absolutely prohibited. Possession alone is treated as malpractice.
mobile_phone_policy.campus_photography: Photography/video of classrooms, labs, or administrative areas requires prior permission.

anti_ragging_policy.definition: Ragging means any act that causes or is likely to cause physical or psychological harm to a fresher or junior student.
anti_ragging_policy.anti_ragging_committee: Chaired by Principal; includes faculty, students, and external members
complaint_mechanism: Anonymous complaint box at: Main Block Reception, Hostel Office
punishment_range: Expulsion and debarment from other institutions

sexual_harassment_policy.iqac_complaint_committee: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) as per POSH Act 2013
sexual_harassment_policy.procedure: Submit written complaint to ICC within 3 months of incident. ICC will investigate and submit report within 90 days.

promotion_criteria.year_1_to_2: Must pass all year 1 subjects OR have not more than 4 arrears
promotion_criteria.year_2_to_3: Must pass all year 1 subjects and have not more than 4 arrears from year 2
promotion_criteria.year_3_to_4: Must pass all year 1 and 2 subjects; max 4 arrears from year 3
promotion_criteria.final_year_completion: All 160 credits must be earned with CGPA >= 4.0

leave_policy.medical_leave: Submit medical certificate from MBBS registered doctor within 3 days of return
leave_policy.prior_leave: Application to HOD at least 3 working days in advance
leave_policy.maximum_leave_per_semester: Not more than 15 days (beyond which attendance falls below 75%)

plagiarism_policy.threshold: Similarity index above 20% in assignments/reports is treated as plagiarism
plagiarism_policy.first_offense: Zero marks for the assignment; written warning
plagiarism_policy.second_offense: Zero marks for all internal assessments in that subject

project_guidelines.mini_project: Semester 5 – team of 2-3 students; must be domain-relevant
project_guidelines.main_project: Semester 7-8 – team of 3-4 students; industry-standard documentation required
project_guidelines.project_report_format: As per GITS guidelines available on LMS
project_guidelines.guide_allocation: Assigned by HOD based on area of interest

curfew_timings.boys_hostel: 10:30 PM on weekdays, 11:00 PM on weekends
curfew_timings.girls_hostel: 9:30 PM on weekdays, 10:00 PM on weekends

visitor_policy.visitors: Only parents/guardians (prior registration required at hostel office)

hostel_rules_list: Maintain silence in corridors between 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM.
Cooking using electrical appliances (heaters, induction, etc.) is prohibited except in designated cooking areas.
Illegal possession of alcohol, tobacco, or drugs leads to immediate expulsion from hostel.
Any vehicle parked in hostel premises must be registered with the transport office.
Keep rooms clean and tidy; room inspection will be conducted fortnightly.
Electrical fittings must not be tampered with.
Leave the hostel premises only after signing the hostel leave register.
Late entry without valid reason: INR 100 fine per occurrence; 3rd offense leads to hostel expulsion.
Wi-Fi is provided from 6:00 AM – 11:00 PM (extended on exam request).
Power cuts for study: 11:00 PM; emergency lights remain on.
